display.use: Big titles only: screen titles, trip names, the share amount

glass.regular: background: rgba(255,255,255,.56); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(180%); box-shadow: inset 1.5px 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.75), inset -1px -1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.07), 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
glass.sheet: background: rgba(250,250,252,.84); backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(180%); box-shadow: inset 1.5px 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.8), inset -1px -1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.5), 0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 -8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
glass.clearOnArt: background: rgba(20,16,30,.35); backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(160%); box-shadow: inset 1px 1px .5px rgba(255,255,255,.45), inset -.5px -.5px .5px rgba(255,255,255,.2), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
glass.prominent: background: #C8402B; box-shadow: inset 1.5px 1.5px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.35), inset -1px -1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,.15), 0 6px 18px rgba(200,64,43,.32);
